constraints.name: bending stiffness
constraints.text: transverse bending stiffness such that no more than 5 mm deflection under 50 N (cantilever, tip load along z, user answer 2026-11-19): k >= 50 N / 5 mm = 10 N/mm

constraints.name: buckling
constraints.text: 50 N under compression buckling load pin-pin

constraints.name: torsional stiffness
constraints.text: torsional stiffness such that it will not rotate more than 1 degrees under 1 Nmm torque

constraints.name: no failure under the torque
constraints.text: Hashin F < 1 under the 1 N mm torque (study step loadcases)

constraints.name: no failure: axial50N
constraints.text: ensure to check no material failure throughout the simulation runs: Hashin F < 1 under a 50 N axial compression tip load, linear, cantilever (user answer 2026-11-19)

constraints.name: coiling on hub
constraints.text: coil on 40 mm hub (radius, user answer 2026-11-19)
